directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand and ui-mockup, conceptual ORIGINAL visual-identity proof sheet for the real macOS product "loppi" (l-o-p-p-i, always lowercase).
The user likes reference 1's warm, clean everyday comfort, but says it is still ORDINARY. Your job is to make a distinctive, rigorous brand identity, beyond changing colors or choosing a stock rounded font. Product: quiet mint pixel rabbit keeps laptop sound while you work; return to moments, recordings and transcripts later. Its role is an undemanding deskside companion. Calm, thoughtful, personable, enduring. Users do not feed or care for it.

Input images: 1 = selected A2 interface, reference for warmth and readable content; freely evolve its visual identity, do not just reproduce its whole screen. 2 = exact current upright pixel rabbit, character identity reference. 3 = exact current sleeping rabbit, character identity reference. Preserve this rabbit's mint, cream, peach palette, compact proportions and upright ears when awake. Pixel rabbit stays crisp at small size. Existing app icon's folded ear is NOT a requirement.

Output ONE flat, frontal, large LANDSCAPE 3:2 identity proof sheet, contemporary independent-software identity design of exceptional craft. This is a study, not final files. No laptop mockup, merchandising, stationery photos, scrapbook, 3D render, decorative wallpaper, fake paper grain, glows, gradients or glass. Present the visual language in actual relevant applications, not a palette next to the same old app screenshot. Sparse labels and ample controlled breathing room. High readability.

Composition: approximately the left third is a carefully typeset identity study: large custom-drawn wordmark "loppi", ONE simple secondary graphic primitive, upright and sleeping rabbit specimens, five quiet color chips, and a concise small Chinese concept title. The right two-thirds contains three highly refined, legible product-use fragments stacked with generous spacing: (1) timeline fragment, (2) transcript/playback fragment, (3) a wide black desktop entry hover panel. A slim lower band demonstrates a single highly composed open-source release COVER, with just the wordmark, small rabbit, understated text "声音留在这里。" and the chosen primitive. Give this cover its own composed negative space; it should look ownable, not a website hero or template card.

Timeline fragment: Chinese-first and practical. Header "10月31日" at MODEST size, small "星期六". A small rabbit next to "正在记录" at upper right. A compact real dual audio-source index marked "麦克风" and "电脑声音"; recording bar intervals, tiny time ticks and one current-time marker, total visual weight low. Open-page list with fine rules, stable timestamps, title "产品设计讨论", time "14:00—15:20", two-line real content "讨论时间线的简化，以及兔子与界面的关系。", small "3 条现场记录". Another row "午后随记" "12:40—12:52". NO pill badge farm, no large date icon, no bounding cards around every row.
Transcript fragment: "产品设计讨论", a small real play button and simple progress rail with tabular "08:24 / 1:20:00", readable "小林 14:08" and text "让它安静地待在桌边，需要的时候，再回到这一刻。"; a modest saved-note entry at right, time "14:12", text "保留这段关于兔子的讨论。". Highlight one active line, not entire prose in accent color.
Desktop panel: opaque warm nearblack, ONE small rabbit at left, three clear actions "截图" "重点" "笔记". No giant recording clock, no volume meter, no extra pet.
The product should be light and warm. Main canvas ivory near #FAF8F2; charcoal type near #292C28; warm-grey rules; the original rabbit mint; one peach/apricot brand accent derived from the rabbit's nose/ears with a darker terracotta ink for accessible small text. Don't make every text or button green. Strong contrast, no muddy sepia. UI should remain usable at ordinary desktop size. Moderate Chinese sans; tabular time figures. Brand type may be custom. Avoid generic AI symbols, infinity marks, quotation-mark logos, soundwave logos, hard surveillance aesthetics, childish balloon type, fake serif nostalgia, sticker overload and a forced bunny-ear on every letter. No font names or meaningless annotation paragraphs.
CONCEPT TITLE "像素的温度".
Creative spine: bring the existing rabbit's precise pixel-step edges into a very small, ownable piece of the identity, held in a warm contemporary typographic system. CUSTOM WORDMARK: draw "loppi" as a coherent original humanist lowercase wordmark, medium-bold with softly squared bowls, comfortable open counters, a gently hooked l, rhythmically matched double p and a tiny peach square i dot. One carefully chosen two-step cut detail at the p descender foot or i dot can echo the rabbit's pixel grid; the word is still smooth, highly readable and mature. It must not be a stock geometric rounded "loppi".
One secondary primitive: a small softly squared peach mark with a single two-pixel step on ONE corner. It acts as a tiny time bookmark in the timeline and a saved-moment locator in the transcript. Clear labels distinguish those roles. Keep true playback symbols standard; the mark never imitates pause bars. Show a clean enlarged specimen, then use it no more than 1–2 times in each interface fragment.
A single enlarged stepped edge may anchor the release cover composition; rest of cover is beautiful empty ivory space, clear wordmark and a tiny rabbit. No pixelation of Chinese text or all controls. Rabbit remains the only detailed illustration. Choose exact proportions and optical rhythm with designer conviction. Emotion: a little digital creature lives inside a thoughtfully made everyday object.

Creative spine: loppi quietly leaves a place to return to, like a tiny pencilled margin mark beside a remembered moment. Develop an ORIGINAL one-stroke, open-corner time-bookmark primitive, compact and asymmetrical, combining a short vertical warm-terracotta line with a tiny inward square foot; understated and perfectly balanced. It must NOT resemble quotation marks, brackets around text, a cursor caret, pause bars or an app-code logo. It can sit precisely beside a timestamp, as a small saved-note locator, and as the current timeline index cap. Keep it sparse; no huge decorative brackets in the app.
CUSTOM WORDMARK: original quietly friendly lowercase sans "loppi", an elegant broad open o, paired p bowls with subtly flattened inner contours and a soft human l, square peach i dot; medium weight, calm, optical rather than geometric. Brand wordmark must feel distinct and warm, not a stock logo with ears pasted on.
The underlying UI typographic system is confident and editorial but contemporary: open-page entries, timestamps treated like marginal annotations, main content held by shared left alignment, charcoal active states and one small terracotta time mark. No white cards around every item, no faux handwriting. The release cover uses ONE simple open-corner motif at generous scale, composed with small "loppi" and rabbit in a large ivory field. This motif frames a remembered moment subtly, never becomes a giant logo frame.
Emotion: deeply personal, precise yet unforced; the mark says 'you can return here'.

Use case: ui-mockup and logo-brand. Design a genuinely polished final-round CONCEPT proof for "loppi", a warm, understated, contemporary macOS audio-recording companion with an exact small mint pixel rabbit. This is exploration, not final implementation.

References: image 1 is the selected comfortable everyday UI direction, retain its paper warmth and open-page entries. Image 2 is the pixel identity experiment, retain only the apricot/mint/charcoal/ivory relationship and a tiny pixel echo; its wordmark is TOO HEAVY and its large peach stepped symbol looks like a folder, so do not reproduce that large graphic. Image 3 is the exact current listening rabbit, preserve its two upright ears, cream muzzle, peach ear interiors, mint pixel silhouette. Image 4 exact sleeping rabbit, supporting identity specimen.

ONE LARGE LANDSCAPE 3:2 flat frontal art-direction board. The top ~82% contains one COMPLETE beautiful and realistic macOS app window, nearly edge-to-edge, with every window edge visible. The lower ~18% is a very restrained identity band: modest custom wordmark, an upright and a sleeping rabbit, five small color chips, and ONE black compact desktop hover panel. No huge decorative abstract symbol, no extra monogram, no pointless slogan, no geometric logo unrelated to the rabbit. No merchandise or physical photos.

CREATIVE GOAL: the wordmark, time margins, small apricot accents and mint rabbit should feel like a single finely made everyday object. Originality comes from consistent optical craft, distinctive type rhythm, exact warm/cool proportion and sparse tiny square details, not extra decoration. A discerning designer should see a clear identity in a screen crop without a huge mascot. Calm confidence, light warmth, beautiful readable Chinese. No fashion-magazine serif, no wellness lavender, no retro recorder styling, no stock AI-app chrome.

COLOR: main paper is almost white #FAF8F3 (flat, no texture or yellow wash), sidebar warm stone #F0EDE5, soft warm charcoal #292D29 for text, dark taupe #68665F metadata, pale warm grey #DED9D0 fine rules. Rabbit mint #8BBDA1. Apricot #F3A181 is a tiny human touch derived from the rabbit's ears/nose; darker clay #A6533C for active text when required for readability. Primary actions use charcoal. Apricot must not become a health-status dot: recording state remains explicit text and mint rabbit. No green body text, no gradients, no glows.

WORDMARK: custom-draw lowercase "loppi" in a medium-weight HUMANIST SANS, thinner and more airy than image 2 by about 25%. Tall gently curved l with a subtle foot, slightly soft-square open o, double p with clear open counters and an unhurried repeated rhythm, small i with a tiny peach SQUARE dot. On only the i dot, a nearly imperceptible 1-step edge can echo the pixel rabbit. No bunny-ear letters, no bubble font, no thick cartoon type, no all-round geometric circles. It must read clearly as "loppi". Wordmark appears modestly in the sidebar and once in the identity band.

MAIN APP approximately 1120x760 logical aspect, highly usable scale. Native macOS traffic lights and proper top-left clear space. Sidebar about 150 logical pixels, exact subtle warm-stone separation, wordmark around 26px. Navigation "时间线" (selected), "处理队列", "人物库", "Agent 接入", with "设置" anchored near bottom. Light, thin-line icons around 16px; selected nav uses charcoal text and a SINGLE tiny clay square, with NO colored pill or white rectangular selection card. No arbitrary icon variation. Quiet nav is subordinate to content.

Main content left margin ~32px. Header date "10月31日" at only ~28px with medium weight; inline "星期六 · 今天" secondary. Tiny simple date chevrons aligned next to date. Upper right ONE rabbit about 42px logical next to compact "正在记录", second line "麦克风与电脑声音"; small outlined pause control, no recording timer. Header total visual height ~80px.

Below, a very slim 2-source daily index directly on paper, no bounding card, no heading or legend. Two lanes labelled "麦克风" "电脑声音"; neutral hairline tracks with a few exact mint recording intervals. Ticks 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00, 24:00 at equal quarters. One thin muted-clay marker for 19:31 at 81.3% across full 24h span, tiny square cap and small time label. NO bars past 19:31. This entire index including labels should use only about 80 logical pixels. It must be distinctly secondary.

Then a roomy but controlled OPEN DAY PAGE. Small label "当天记录" and count 4, right a small charcoal button "+ 新建事件", rectangle 5px corners. Four records newest first with spacious, practical type hierarchy and a STABLE timeline time gutter; fine horizontal rules, no cards and no outer box per row. Put start and end times on separate aligned lines in the gutter, tabular digits; a very fine vertical rail aligns all content entries. Time captions are readable dark taupe, title medium-weight ~16px, text ~14px. Keep description line length comfortable. No oversized meta symbols, no excessive divider nesting.

Row 1: 19:20 / 至今, title "此刻的记录", real excerpt "我希望它像一个安静的桌边伙伴，有性格，也有温度。", small "正在记录". Its tiny marker and timestamp use mint-tinted ink dark enough to read. No colored row background.
Row 2: 14:00 / 15:20, title "产品设计讨论", summary "讨论了时间线的简化，以及兔子与界面的关系。", metadata "麦克风 · 电脑声音     3 条现场记录". One SMALL saved-moment square in apricot can sit beside the count, nothing larger.
Row 3: 12:40 / 12:52, title "午后随记", note "整理了下周的安排，也记下了一些想法。", metadata "1 条笔记".
Row 4: 10:15 / 11:05, title "一次关于开源的对话", summary "聊到独立工具的长期价值，以及如何让它持续生长。", metadata "麦克风 · 电脑声音     2 条现场记录".
All rows fully visible, generous line spacing, modest overall density, genuinely attractive rhythm. Do not surround the page in extra dashboard cards. Quiet affordances near right edge may appear only as small ellipses.

Lower identity band: warm ivory, thin top divider; five small SQUARE paint chips and no large color discs; exact wordmark as above; original rabbit poses; black compact entry panel uses one rabbit plus clearly labelled "截图" "重点" "笔记", thin simple line icons. Black panel gently rounded 6px and no 3D gradients. Pixel corner detail used at most once or twice in the entire image. Main window corner radius ~10px, minimal neutral shadow only, no glare. Overall image should be crisp 2D high-resolution design, not a hazy photograph. Readability and designer-quality optical alignment are paramount.

Create one exceptionally beautiful, distinctive, believable MACOS APPLICATION SCREEN for "loppi", a small personal audio archive represented by a mint pixel rabbit. This is a spatial/art-direction exploration, NOT a website, NOT a brand presentation board. Show ONLY one complete app window, front-on, almost filling the LANDSCAPE 3:2 image, all edges visible. No palette strip, no side explanation panel, no laptop render, no marketing poster.

User likes a "清爽日常" direction: warm near-white paper, soft black readable text, precise everyday typography, a little mint rabbit and a tiny peach accent. It feels comfortable but all previous designs were too ordinary, like the same generic app sidebar plus dashboard and rows. Bring an independent designer's conviction to a NEW, serene, personal spatial composition. It should feel like an object with its own identity that someone enjoys returning to every evening. It is an undemanding deskside companion; no pet care.

REFERENCE IMAGES: image 1 exact current awake rabbit, two upright ears, mint/cream/peach crisp pixels; image 2 its exact sleeping pose, reference only. Preserve identity. The pixel rabbit is the only detailed illustration, small in the UI. Make sophisticated type and composition, no fake textures or childish toys. The rabbit does NOT force the entire app into pixel type.

NEW SPATIAL IDEA: FREE THE DAY PAGE.
A quiet slim top app navigation replaces the dominant vertical sidebar. Native traffic lights top left with appropriate clear space. Small original lowercase "loppi" wordmark at top left after the native controls: medium-weight warm humanist sans, softly squared open bowls, graceful paired p, tiny peach square dot on i. Five destinations along the slim top bar: "时间线" selected by one small dark underline, "处理队列", "人物库", "Agent 接入", "设置". Unhurried spacing, Chinese sans, not a corporate tab bar with big blocks.
Below the slim bar the main page has controlled wide margins and a distinctive asymmetric editorial composition: on the left a calm DAY MARGIN, around 180 logical px wide, with a modest date treatment "10月" small above "31" in refined sans numerals, then "星期六", subtle previous/next day arrows. The date must not dominate beyond the typography of a small desktop object. Below the date a small awake mint rabbit and "正在记录", smaller "麦克风与电脑声音" and a compact pause control. This quiet date-and-companion margin is NOT a navigation sidebar, has no tinted box, and occupies only part of the page height. A tiny warm square beside "今天" provides a human touch.
The broad RIGHT DAY PAGE starts with a VERY COMPACT factual daily audio index directly on paper, two thin source lanes labelled "麦克风" and "电脑声音", genuine interval rectangles in muted mint on barely-there warm grey hairlines. Ticks 00:00 06:00 12:00 18:00 24:00. Current time 19:31 shown at 81.3% across the full 24h axis with a tiny clay tick and square cap; no interval past now. Entire index is only about 80px logical tall. No card, no heading, no repeated legend.
Below it, a small editorial label "当天记录" and a tiny count "4"; at far right the compact textual action "+ 新建事件", visually secondary. The day records are an airy CONTINUOUS OPEN PAGE using excellent alignment and fine rules, not a grid of boxes or stacked cards. Stable narrow time column, medium-weight Chinese titles and calm readable excerpts. Carefully vary the rhythm with content length instead of making every row identical-height and dead. Warm-charcoal 15px reading text, 17px titles, darker readable metadata. Short line lengths, no stretched text. Four entries:
"19:20 — 至今" / "此刻的记录" / "我希望它像一个安静的桌边伙伴，有性格，也有温度。" / tiny "正在记录".
"14:00 — 15:20" / "把 loppi 做得更安静" / "讨论时间线的简化，以及兔子与界面的关系。" / small "麦克风 · 电脑声音    3 条现场记录".
"12:40 — 12:52" / "午后随记" / "整理了下周的安排，也记下了一些想法。" / small "1 条笔记".
"10:15 — 11:05" / "一次关于开源的对话" / "聊到独立工具的长期价值，以及如何让它持续生长。" / small "2 条现场记录".
All four fully visible, fine taupe time figures, a single thin rail can connect them subtly with tiny square marks. No prominent rounded-rectangle containers around entries. Hover affordances quiet at row end.

Palette and material: almost white warm ivory #FAF8F3 for the WHOLE page including date margin, charcoal #292D29, taupe #68665F metadata, delicate #DED9D0 rules, exact rabbit mint #8BBDA1, a TINY apricot #F3A181 detail for wordmark i and saved-moment marks, dark clay #A6533C for tiny active time ink. White opaque flat surfaces, no beige haze, no gradient, no glassmorphism, no abstract waves, no bento tiles, no sparkles, no enormous recording clock or waveform. The key is decisively original composition with a private, understated warm identity. Be precise and bold in craft, restrained in number of elements. Real macOS utility quality, impeccably legible Chinese and typography, no invented extra content or features.

pixel.promising: Color relationship derived from rabbit and tiny square detail connects brand and UI.
pixel.rejectedByDesigner: Large stepped symbol resembles a folder/hand and adds a redundant second mark. Heavy wordmark too cute. Keep these unselected rather than treating as final logo.

margin.promising: Marginal time annotation is relevant to returning to moments.
margin.rejectedByDesigner: L mark arbitrary, weak rabbit connection, unnecessary second logo. Not selected for continued designer recommendation.

refined.promising: Reduced logo weight, subtle peach i dot, shared warm neutral foundation, simple temporal rail.
refined.limitation: Nearly identical overall composition to round 2. Mostly polish; insufficient to resolve user's concern about ordinary design. Generator fails to make main button charcoal and retains large date/nav emphasis.

spatial.promising: Top navigation frees the day page. Date and rabbit share quiet left margin; makes companion present beside the day's records. Main content is more like a personal page.
spatial.limitation: Explores moving navigation and status, which changes UX and is NOT approved. Rabbit and pause are too large. Recording text uses clay/orange, violating planned healthy mint/charcoal semantics; fix in any continued candidate. Source timeline and timestamps approximate. Needs dense/empty/details/narrow-window validation.

review.general: All images are conceptual raster studies with non-authoritative labels, motifs and data. No production assets replaced and no implementation approval implied.
